decisions.decision: Topology map (vis-network) moved out of Phase 11 into new Phase 13
decisions.rationale: Checkmk's `parents` attribute is unset on the target site, so an auto-built map renders as disconnected dots. Hand-drawing needs layout persistence with no backend — an unsolved problem. The real fix is teaching the wizard to set `parents` over REST, as Phase 10 does for tag_device_type, which is wizard work not dashboard work.

decisions.decision: Agent metrics (CPU/RAM/disk/SMART gauges) and per-service status moved into new Phase 12
decisions.rationale: The poller issues only `GET hosts` and never queries the `services` table — no per-service state, plugin_output or perf_data exists in the contract. Adding them is a new query, topic, perfdata parser and UI. Also contradicts a locked PROJECT.md Out of Scope entry, so it needs its own phase rather than being folded in silently.

decisions.decision: DASH-01 split; map half became DASH-07 owned by Phase 13
decisions.rationale: DASH-01 conflated two deliverables. Leaving it whole would have made plan-phase's requirements-coverage gate demand a map plan from Phase 11.

decisions.decision: D-17: extend the Phase 9 poller contract with Checkmk's `staleness` and the real host state (DOWN vs UNREACHABLE)
decisions.rationale: Operator chose this against the recommendation to defer, after being told the cost. Makes Phase 11 edit scripts/mqtt_poller.py and tests/test_mqtt_poller.py, so it is no longer a purely backend-less consumer phase. Both fields are additive so existing subscribers stay valid.

decisions.decision: D-11: mirror Checkmk's own state palette rather than inventing one
decisions.rationale: Verified against docs.checkmk.com — UNKNOWN is orange in Checkmk, not grey, and grey means PEND/never-polled. This corrected an earlier answer given to the operator. Grey is now reserved for the dashboard's own stale condition.

decisions.decision: D-12: staleness at 3x the poll interval, not Checkmk's 1.5x
decisions.rationale: Checkmk's 1.5x factor works because its checks are scheduled locally. This chain adds a Livestatus query, MQTT publish, broker hop and browser, so 1.5x would flag the whole fleet stale whenever one cycle runs long. 3x absorbs exactly one missed cycle.

decisions.decision: D-21/D-23: three real HTML files sharing one shell.js, with pushState-intercepted navigation and an in-place detail panel
decisions.rationale: The operator asked for single-page view switching, which would have left devices.html and details.html non-existent and contradicted three locked requirements. This shape satisfies DASH-01/02/03 literally while keeping one persistent MQTT connection — and is what makes the operator's 'event history always visible' requirement actually true.

context_notes: Phase 11 went through two discussion rounds. The first captured 22 decisions across four gray areas. The second — triggered by the operator asking for agent metrics and saying the map would have to be hand-drawn — cut the phase down substantially and spawned Phases 12 and 13. The current CONTEXT.md carries a <scope_revision> block at the top that the planner must read; it lists exactly what moved out and why. Decisions D-08 and D-09 (synthetic group-roots, stabilize-then-freeze physics) were deliberately left fully reasoned in 11-DISCUSSION-LOG.md and referenced from Phase 13's roadmap entry so that phase does not re-derive them. The phase is now a genuinely small consumer phase plus one poller edit (D-17).
